task.title: P6-018: Add /my/all to both authoritative route maps
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 10 — Hygiene and docs). Original id: P6-018. Size: S. Specs: specs/app-ui.md, specs/ui-design.md.

**`/my/all` is missing from both authoritative route maps** — `specs/app-ui.md:62-71` and `design/information-architecture.md:99-108`. The route shipped with the mobile-`/my` task (and `app-ui.md:327` proves it is live), so an agent reading either map will not know it exists. Two rows.
